views_source: Final exact GLB loaded in repository Three.js 186 and Chromium 153 with software WebGL. Stills are exported-model raster, not authoring viewport.

lead_review.source: Lead /root reviewed four early and revised views, then exact final beauty and approximately 200 px attack strip.
corrections: Made cream tail section abut rather than overlap russet shell.
Moved contact fan outward while retaining forward extension for the three-quarter camera.

visual_inspection.front: Broad russet head and segmented limbs, tired lowered lids, blunt muzzle, plain worn green vest and distinct hand card fan.
visual_inspection.side: Long blunt muzzle and thick attached tail; no muzzle/card intersections.
visual_inspection.back: One attached padded russet/cream tail, repaired seam, plain green back panel.
visual_inspection.beauty: Supporting-performer scale and subdued non-pirate appearance.
visual_inspection.idle: Small mechanical head, ear and card motion; steady padded feet.
visual_inspection.move: Stationary stiff shuffle, alternating lift and visible small-scale motion.
visual_inspection.attack: Raised fan warning, held 0.85 to 1.08 s; forward/outward card snap at 1.25 s, outside vest in final gameplay-scale frame.
visual_inspection.defeat: Bent knees and bowed head with card droop and tail fold; visible held final pose, no authored hiding or scaling.
visual_inspection.small_scale: All five clips sampled at 0%, 30%, 62.5%, 100% and played continuously at 0.35 camera zoom. Distinct frames are recorded for each.

technical_limits: Chromium ANGLE SwiftShader proves actual WebGL loading and animation; it does not establish iPhone/iPad Safari or physical-device frame time.
Contact time is authored pose timing; collision, projectiles, effects and encounter eligibility belong to later gameplay.
Conservative all-frame card clearance is distance between exact deformed card/head/torso AABBs. It is a lower bound on actual surface separation.
Bind-pose floor minimum -0.00000119 m is floating-point skin/transform noise within 0.00001 m tolerance. Animated feet remain at least 0.001970 m above floor.
The two-material character uses a single roughness class for old glass and mechanics, so the glass remains deliberately dull.
